finding.root_cause: The request inventory contained only ordered pair/triple partitions of target (1,1,1), so it could not include the singleton cubic logdet insertion K3 with multiindex (1,1,1).

scientific_interpretation: This is a scoped gate-design/completeness failure, not a failure of the physical H/N kernels and not a Candidate Gravity consistency failure. No threshold was weakened and Iteration 325 was not retroactively edited.
resolution: Create a new gate version, Iteration 326, adding the missing singleton Tr(G0 K3) topology while keeping physical kernels, finite-difference h and thresholds unchanged.
